capabilities: Annotate PDFs with pressure-aware pen, highlighter, shapes, text boxes and images
Insert blank, ruled, grid or dotted writing pages into a PDF
Recognize handwriting into selectable read-only text via OCR providers
Embed annotated pages or regions into Markdown notes
Export a separate annotated PDF copy while keeping the original unchanged
disambiguation: Not a freeform drawing canvas; annotations attach to PDF pages and are stored beside the PDF file.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Annotations live in a companion .annot.json file that must be kept with the PDF when backing up or syncing. Online OCR requires your own API credentials and may incur usage charges; dense annotation pages can render slowly. Requires Obsidian 1.12.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian's PDF viewer is read-only, so there is no way to write, draw or mark up PDFs inside the app.

relations.evidence: Optional OCR with Gemini, an OpenAI-compatible service or a separately installed local helper.
Optional OCR with Gemini, an OpenAI-compatible service or a separately installed local helper.

summary: PDF annotation layer for Obsidian's viewer that adds stylus handwriting, shapes, text, images, writing pages, OCR and annotated PDF export.
